title: Ultimate Snack Food Clipart Bundle
author: Mine Eyes Design
description:
Thank you for shopping at Mine Eyes Design
This listing is for 56 original snack themed clipart images. 
These images are perfect for:
school projects
restaurant promotion
after school parties
party invitations
scrapbooking
homemade invitations
decorations
greeting cards
printing on paper or fabric
craft projects
personal newsletters
sublimation png projects
any other creative personal use!
Upon ordering you will immediately receive a zip file containing:
– 56 PNG files with transparent background (MEDIUM ~1000 pixels wide)
– 56 JPEG files with white background (LARGE ~4160 pixels wide)
– 56 SVG files (scalable vector graphics, not flattened for cutting)
If you have any questions about these files or what they can be used for please message me before purchasing!
Specs:
– Files are high resolution (300 dpi)
– Printable at 300dpi up to 11 inches
– Transparent background makes it easy to drop clip art on your own project
– Watermark will not appear on purchased product
– You will not receive any printed product.
